Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane on a Baytown, Texas roadway when Driver 2 began a lane change from the
adjacent left lane without first confirming the lane was clear. The vehicles sideswiped one another, and Driver 1
reported pain in the left wrist after the impact. The injury Driver 1 described is consistent with bracing against the
steering wheel during a sudden lateral collision of this kind. Driver 2 acknowledged the lane change and stated that
the sequence of events occurred as Driver 1 described. Two independent witnesses at the scene gave statements
that matched this account, and photographs taken on scene show damage to the right side of Driver 1's vehicle and
the left side of Driver 2's vehicle, consistent with the reported point of contact. Responding officers observed no prior
damage of any kind to Driver 1's vehicle. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle at
the time of the collision, and both officers and the witnesses confirmed the Passenger's presence. Driver 1 is listed as
the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
